stories.story_fr: SGS observe des périodes calmes avant la publication de ses résultats financiers.
stories.story_en: SGS observes quiet periods ahead of the publication of its financial results.
stories.quote: SGS observes quiet periods ahead of the publication of its financial results.

stories.story_fr: La période calme débute 30 jours avant les résultats annuels et 21 jours avant les mises à jour trimestrielles.
stories.story_en: The quiet period begins 30 calendar days prior to the announcement of the full-year and half-year results, and 21 calendar days prior to the publication of quarterly sales updates.
stories.quote: The quiet period begins 30 calendar days prior to the announcement of the full-year and half-year results, and 21 calendar days prior to the publication of quarterly sales updates.

stories.story_fr: Pendant ces périodes, SGS ne discute pas de performances financières avec les analystes ou investisseurs.
stories.story_en: During these periods, SGS does not engage in discussions with analysts or investors regarding financial performance, outlook, or market-sensitive information.
stories.quote: During these periods, SGS does not engage in discussions with analysts or investors regarding financial performance, outlook, or market-sensitive information.
